🏛️ 7527 SAYILI KANUNUN İPTALİ İÇİN İMZAC: 🏛️ SIGN FOR THE REPEAL OF LAW 7527
Sayın Milletvekili, 7527 sayılı Kanun'un: Dear MP, support this historic call with your signature for the repeal of Law 7527 and a return to Law 5199.
📲 İmza nasıl atılır? Adım adım gör: 📲 How to sign? Step by step
Aşağıdaki metni okuyup imzalayınız: Please read the text below and sign
İmzanız doğrulanarak meclis sayaçlarına: Your signature is verified and added to the parliament counters.
Ad-soyadım, TBMM e-posta adresim ve imza: I agree that my name, TBMM e-mail and signature are processed within the campaign and published in the list of signatory MPs.
Arkadaşınızın adını seçin: link onun adı: Choose your colleague's name: the link opens with their name and parliament e-mail filled in.
Sayın Milletvekili, yurttaşların dilekçe: Dear MP, citizens' petitions have reached you. Choose your name from the list, enter your parliament e-mail, read the declaration and sign; it goes to the Speaker's Office in your name.
Halkın iradesinden neden rahatsızsınız?: Why does the will of the people disturb you?
25 Eylül'de bir dilekçe kampanyasından ç: On 25 September we started far more than a petition campaign.
Yıllardır hayvanların yaşam hakkını orta: We investigated how the system that has taken away animals' right to life for years was built. We went back through the parliamentary records. We laid out how the law was passed, the political responsibilities, the votes, and the promises made and broken.
Sahadaki vahşeti, katliamları ve hukuksu: We built a system that records the cruelty, massacres and lawlessness on the ground and carries the people's will directly to the decision-makers. We prepared not only for today but also for what must be done after the law is repealed.
Çünkü biz bu ülkenin hayvanlarını kurtar: Because we want to save this country's animals. We are not fighting to wait for the next disaster, the next statement or the next workshop, but to solve the problem at its source.
Bu çalışmayı hayvan hakları dernek ve in: We brought this work to animal rights associations and initiatives, to political parties and MPs, and to well-known animal advocates. We didn't ask for more than this: send your petition, share it. We showed how to take part.
İki ay boyunca karşılığında sessizlik, i: For two months we were met with silence, indifference and opposition. Then we watched everyone start doing something again.
İtirazımız kimsenin kampanya yapmasına,: We don't object to anyone running a campaign, collecting signatures or holding a workshop. We object to the attitude of associations, initiatives, parties and individuals who say they defend animals' right to life, when the people act on their own behalf.
Bu mücadele hiçbir derneğin, platformun,: This struggle is not the property of any association, platform, party, group or person. Those who try to squeeze the people's will into their institutional turf, political calculations and chains of command should know:
In this fight we are not soldiers, we are fighters.
Mücadelemiz birilerinin bayrak taşıması: Our struggle is not so that someone can carry the flag, but to secure animals' right to life. We have shown that what has been talked about for years without result can be achieved by the people's own will.
We will not give up this will.
7527 İPTAL! Halkın iradesiyle, doğrudan,: REPEAL 7527! By the will of the people, directly, together.
Halkın iradesi vekillerin önünde: The people's will is before the MPs
Sign and spread it. Every signature is for a life.
Sen de gel, sesimizi birlikte yükselteli: Come along, let's raise our voice together.
Davayı takip ediyoruz, cezasızlığa izin: We follow the cases; no to impunity. The fuller the courtroom, the harder it is to turn a blind eye to impunity.
